sources.title: Run Lythri-4B-A2B API (Easy Deployment & Flat-Rate Pricing)
sources.snippet: Lythri/Lythri-4B-A2B is a 5.1 billion parameter on-device language model developed by Lythri, built on Gemma 4 E2B. This model is specifically trained for emotional companionship and natural, multi-turn conversations, designed to run efficiently on local devices. It prioritizes understanding human emotions over traditional benchmarks like math or coding, offering a context length of 32768 tokens.

sources.snippet: Lythri is a family of on-device language models built for emotional companionship. Instead of chasing math and coding scores, Lythri is trained to understand how people feel and to hold natural, multi-turn conversations, while staying small enough to run locally on a laptop or phone.
